name: gatestack
description: GateStack: an educational 32-bit computer simulator (Rust/WASM core, React UI, Electron)

scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml && cd web && npm run build:wasm && npm test && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.build: cd web && npm run build:wasm && npm run electron:build:win
scripts.ship: npm run release && npm run build && git push --follow-tags origin main
